title: Calibration Routine

story.briefing: Every sensor in Sector 8 drifted by the same amount during the outage. Correct them all — but the housings physically cannot register a value outside their rated band.
story.success: Sensors calibrated. The readings agree with each other for the first time in years.

description: Given an array of readings and an integer offset, add the offset to every reading. Any result below 0 becomes 0, and any result above 100 becomes 100. Return the corrected array. The input array may be empty, in which case return an empty array.
hints: The same correction applies to every element, so this is one transformation repeated. A helper that clamps a single value keeps the loop clean.
Clamping needs both bounds. Handling only the upper bound is the usual mistake, and a negative offset will expose it immediately.
For each reading compute reading + offset, then take the larger of that and 0, then the smaller of the result and 100. Collect the values into a new array and return it.
